secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service_role key — from Supabase dashboard → Settings → API → service_role. Needed for admin API routes.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Alternative name for the Supabase secret key. Same value as SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.

secrets.name: PSP_API_KEY
secrets.description: Mobile Money gateway API key (Airtel Money / Moov Money) for payment escrow.

secrets.name: UP_ADMIN_SECURITY_KEY
secrets.description: Admin security key for the /api/admin/auth endpoint. Defaults to 'UP2026' in code.
